title: Jenifer Garner Opens Up About Family Life After Ben Affleck Split
text:
Actress Jenifer Garner discusses the impact of her divorce from Ben Affleck on her family life and career, revealing that she took time off from acting to focus on her children and remains selective about projects now.
Jenifer Garner has opened up about the significant changes in her family life following her 2015 split from Ben Affleck . Initially, she spoke about the time she took off from acting to focus on pregnancy, childbirth, and recovery.
She then revealed how the divorce impacted her career, stating, 'First of all, when you're in a performance kind of role, you give up a year/year-and-a-half of performance while you are pregnant, having a baby, recovering.
' After her kids were born, Garner focused on raising them and worked minimally. However, she mentioned that the divorce caused another 'upheaval' in her family life, leading her to take a prolonged break from acting. Now that she's back in Hollywood, Garner is selective about the projects she takes on, preferring those based in Los Angeles to avoid extended periods away from her family. She also reflected on the demanding nature of acting, stating, 'It's a selfish job.
It's not about domestic responsibilities, it's about the schedule.
' Despite this, she's grateful that her children have been understanding about her career. Affleck and Garner married in 2005 and share three children, Violet, Fin, and Samuel, whom they co-parent following their 2018 divorce
